title: kith-tui silently exits when chat list is empty (new user)
description: event.rs:876-879: run() returns Ok(()) early if chat_ids.get(selected_chat) is None after load_startup_data. For a new user with no chats, the TUI appears briefly and exits with no message. The event loop never starts. Fix: continue into the event loop with an empty chat list and display a user-visible hint (e.g. 'No chats yet — add a contact first').
